mapper.select: SELECT id, notification_type as notificationType, title, message, is_read as isRead, created_at as createdAt, url FROM notifications WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE notifications SET is_read = TRUE WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_read = FALSE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notifications (user_id, notification_type, title, message, url) VALUES (#{userId}, #{type}, #{title}, #{message}, #{url})
